instruction: I need to undelete the poster_party_night.webp file that I removed earlier. Please recover it from Trash to the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Desktop/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Undelete task with precise file path specification. Evaluator checks file presence on Desktop using shell command.
